steps.lines: The five lines of the treble staff, from the bottom: {e}, {g}, {b}, {d} and {f}. From one line to the next you skip a white key.
steps.quizLines: Play the notes on the lines.
steps.spaces: The four spaces, from the bottom: {f}, {a}, {c} and {e}: the white keys between the line notes.
steps.quizSpaces: Play the notes in the spaces.
steps.quizAll: Lines and spaces mixed, plus middle {c} on its ledger line and {d} just below the staff.
